fields.hint: Required. Shown as the system name in the report.

fields.hint: Operator roles under the AIA. A single company often holds several.

Deployer

fields.name: is_ai_system
fields.hint: Treated as an in-scope AI system unless set otherwise.

fields.name: excluded_use_flags
fields.hint: Scope exclusions or carve-outs that need visible review.

options.label: Military, defence or national security
Research, development or testing
Personal, non-professional use
Free and open-source licence

fields.name: placing_on_market_date
fields.hint: YYYY-MM-DD, the AI system's date. Drives Art. 111(2) and (4) AIA; for a GPAI model without its own date, also Art. 111(3).

fields.name: putting_into_service_date
fields.hint: YYYY-MM-DD. Drives Art. 111(2) AIA.

fields.name: significant_change_after_application_date
fields.hint: Art. 111(2) AIA: a significant design change as from the Chapter III date. Which date is contested: 2027-12-02 (Annex III) or 2028-08-02 (Annex I), or the general date 2026-08-02.

fields.name: public_authority_use
fields.hint: Intended to be used by public authorities: the 2 August 2030 deadline in Art. 111(2) AIA and, while the deployer's status is unset, the Art. 49(3) registration of use for review.

fields.name: deployer_public_authority
fields.hint: The deployer is, or acts on behalf of, a public authority or Union institution, body, office or agency: Art. 49(3) AIA registration of use. Unset: inferred for review from public-authority use or Annex III points 5(a), 6 and 7.

fields.name: deployer_public_law_body
fields.hint: Art. 27 AIA: fundamental rights impact assessment.

fields.name: deployer_private_public_service
fields.hint: Art. 27 AIA: fundamental rights impact assessment.

fields.name: provider_established_outside_eu
fields.hint: Art. 22 AIA: authorised representative.

fields.name: has_authorised_representative
fields.hint: Art. 22 AIA.

fields.name: substantially_modifies_system
fields.hint: Value-chain obligations.

fields.name: puts_name_or_trademark_on_system
fields.hint: Value-chain obligations.

fields.name: training_flops
fields.hint: Cumulative training compute in FLOP; drives Art. 51(2) AIA.

fields.name: gpai_systemic_risk_designated
fields.hint: Commission designation under Art. 51(1)(b) AIA.

fields.name: gpai_model_placing_on_market_date
fields.hint: YYYY-MM-DD, the model's own date. Drives Art. 111(3) AIA.

fields.name: prohibited_practices
fields.hint: Keyed to the letters of Art. 5(1) AIA. 5.1.ba and 5.1.bb apply from 2 December 2026.

options.label: Art. 5(1)(a): Subliminal, manipulative or deceptive techniques causing significant harm
Art. 5(1)(b): Exploiting vulnerabilities of age, disability or socio-economic situation
Art. 5(1)(ba): Generating or manipulating realistic intimate material of an identifiable person without consent
Art. 5(1)(bb): Generating or manipulating child sexual abuse material under Directive 2011/93/EU, save a 'without right' defence under national law
Art. 5(1)(c): Social scoring leading to detrimental or unfavourable treatment
Art. 5(1)(d): Predicting criminal offending based solely on profiling or personality
Art. 5(1)(e): Untargeted scraping of facial images to build recognition databases
Art. 5(1)(f): Emotion recognition in the workplace or education (no medical/safety exception)
Art. 5(1)(g): Biometric categorisation inferring sensitive attributes
Art. 5(1)(h): Real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces for law enforcement

fields.name: annex_i_safety_component
fields.hint: Art. 6(1)(a): product or safety component.

fields.name: annex_i_third_party_assessment
fields.hint: Art. 6(1)(b): third-party conformity assessment.

fields.name: annex_i_section
fields.hint: Annex I section of the product. B (incl. machinery, Regulation (EU) 2023/1230): only Art. 6(1), 60a and 102-112 apply, and 57-59 as far as integrated in the sectoral legislation (Art. 2(2) AIA). Unset: Section A.

options.label: Section A
Section B

fields.name: annex_iii_area
fields.hint: Art. 6(2) and Annex III. III.unsure: an area is implicated but the point is unsettled; treated as high-risk and routed to review.

Annex III(1)(b): Biometric categorisation by sensitive/protected attributes
Annex III(1)(c): Emotion recognition
Annex III(2): Safety component of critical infrastructure

Annex III(3)(d): Education: monitoring prohibited behaviour during tests

Annex III(4)(b): Employment: decisions on terms, promotion, termination, task allocation
Annex III(5)(a): Eligibility for essential public assistance benefits and services
Annex III(5)(b): Creditworthiness evaluation and credit scoring
Annex III(5)(c): Risk assessment and pricing in life and health insurance
Annex III(5)(d): Emergency call dispatch and triage
Annex III(6)(a): Law enforcement: risk of a person becoming a victim of crime
Annex III(6)(b): Law enforcement: polygraphs and similar tools
Annex III(6)(c): Law enforcement: evaluating the reliability of evidence
Annex III(6)(d): Law enforcement: assessing the risk of offending or re-offending
Annex III(6)(e): Law enforcement: profiling during detection, investigation or prosecution
Annex III(7)(a): Migration: polygraphs and similar tools
Annex III(7)(b): Migration: risk assessment for persons entering a Member State
Annex III(7)(c): Migration: examining asylum, visa and residence-permit applications
